units.source_text: 岛村仿佛坐上了某种非现实的东西，失去了时间和距离的概念，陷入了迷离恍惚之中，徒然地让它载着自己的身躯奔驰。

en.t: Shimamura felt as if he had boarded something unreal, losing all sense of time and distance, sinking into a dazed trance, and idly letting it carry his body racing onward.

units.source_text: 单调的车轮声，开始听的时候像是女子的絮絮话语。

en.t: The monotonous sound of the wheels, when he first began to listen to it, seemed like a woman's rambling talk.
